title: 'Love at First Spike' earns International Emmy nomination
summary: ABS-CBN Studios and iWant's original series "Love at First Spike," starring Emilio Daez, Sean Tristan, and Reign Parani, bagged nomination at the 2026 International Emmy Awards.
